items.title: Dell’s earning report was bullish for Intel CPU demand, analyst says
items.summary: Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) is the most direct equity expression of the structural shift Chowdhry describes. The firm's $200 price target and a 2031 EPS estimate of $20 rest on three interlocking arguments: rising CPU-to-GPU ratios in AI clusters, x86's entrenched enterprise position, and the architectural advantages of Intel's Clearwater Forest processor.
